name: CGH-based parallel focal point generation
aliases: Computer Generated Hologram parallel voxel generation
definition: Generates multiple focal points in parallel using a phase-only CGH displayed on an LCOS-SLM to increase voxel generation density per frame.
summary: CGH-based parallel focal point generation uses phase-only holograms on an SLM to split a laser into multiple simultaneous focal spots, increasing voxel density beyond single-point rendering.
